mapper.select: select * from Investment_Estimate_Breakdown where Project_ID = #{projectId} and state!=3

select isb.*,pro.P_Name as projectName, sf.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, pro.P_Construction_Unit as projectConstructionUnit,sd.D_Name as projectConstructionUnitName, case when pro.p_project_form_type = '01' then pro.P_Committee_Approva_Document when pro.p_project_form_type = '02' then pro.p_Record_File when pro.p_project_form_type = '03' then pro.p_Apply_File end as projectApplyFile, pro.P_Approve_budget as pApproveBudget, pro.p_record_amount as pRecordAmount, pro.p_approval_amount as pApprovalAmount, pro.p_project_form_type as pProjectFormType, pro.p_inv_total as pInvTotal from Investment_Estimate_Breakdown isb left join Pre_Project pro on isb.Project_ID = pro.P_ID left join SYS_Department sd on pro.P_Construction_Unit = sd.D_ID left join sys_file sf on isb.id=sf.FileId where isb.id = #{id}
select isb.* from Investment_Estimate_Breakdown isb where state=7 and project_id not in (select project_id from Investment_Budget_Breakdown where state = 7)

select isb.*,pro.P_Name as projectName, pro.P_Construction_Unit as projectConstructionUnit,sd.D_Name as projectConstructionUnitName, pro.P_Apply_File as projectApplyFile, pro.P_Approve_budget as pApproveBudget, pro.p_record_amount as pRecordAmount, pro.p_approval_amount as pApprovalAmount, pro.p_project_form_type as pProjectFormType, pro.p_inv_total as pInvTotal from Investment_Estimate_Breakdown isb left join Pre_Project pro on isb.Project_ID = pro.P_ID left join SYS_Department sd on pro.P_Construction_Unit = sd.D_ID where isb.Project_ID = #{projectId} and isb.state!=3
select * from Investment_Estimate_Breakdown where Project_ID = #{projectId} and state=7 order by Create_Time desc
select p_id from pre_project where state = 7 and p_id not in (select project_id from Investment_Estimate_Breakdown where state = 7)
